environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). Traffic passes through directly to the Flask application on port 8080. Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No application-layer inspection. SQLite database file is on local EBS volume with read-write permissions for the app user.

config.database: SQLite on local EBS gp3 volume
